title: Shared definitions for content packs (schema v0)

slug.description: Stable identifier. Lower case words joined by dashes. Never renamed and never reused.

i18n.description: Text in the product languages. English and Polish are required, the others fall back to English.

image.description: A picture kept by the game under the checksum of its bytes: the SHA-256 in lower case hex, a dot and the kind of the file (png, webp or jpg). The bytes are in the store of images (the panel puts them there), not in the pack, so a pack names a picture and a bundle carries it.
